nodes.title: Round 7 contracts (Brain owns shared/contracts.ts): UiDirectives.steer (SteerChip[], SteerId union of 16 ids), UiDirectives.later (LaterEntryUi: id, text ≤ 60, learning, status open/due/returned, when after_question/at_end), UiDirectives.moment (UiMoment: park/detour/decline/stop_check/returned, laterId, topic), TurnRequest.gameAct ({consumed, game, act}: words a game grammar consumed are never graded), TurnRequest.heardUpTo (any lane; duplex.heardUpTo read second), ReplyClauseEvent (one guarded clause of a streamed reply, never withdrawn once sent). A steer tap is the request its words make (server/director/steer.js); steer:wrap2 is read but has no move until PIPELINE A9. Reversal: if App or Voice need a different shape, Brain changes the contract and messages every stream the sha.

Decision D3 is built as ONE band table. shared/learner.ts BANDS (Brain-owned) carries register young (1-3) / preteen (4-6) / teen (7-9), and class 4 contract "10-15". shared/bands.ts exports registerOf / contractBandOf / classesOf. server/learner/bands.js re-exports the table, and ageBandFor reads it (applied here so the gate stays green; patch docs/patches/to-learning/001). Asha’s persona sheets take their class ranges from it (young 1-3, older 4-9), and the agent lane’s register line reads registerOf. A class-4 child now gets the older sheet (peer protégé Bittu, not the baby elephant), the older turn lengths, and the older probe / why shapes. Reversal: if the class-4 talk-share or owner judgement on a live class-4 lesson is worse than the young register, move class 4 back in BANDS (one row). Needs a live check: Asha’s older notes were talk-gated on class 6 only.

PIPELINE §A Brain, week 1. (1) Zero spoken build state or failure. A game ask with no game gets the activity on the screen or a quick spoken game, never "no game is ready". "Show it moving" with nothing moving gets the motion in words, never "nothing moves". A photo coming, busy or failed is never narrated: she talks about the board’s sketch or gives it in words, and a photo that arrives simply appears. The fixed fallback re-asks plainly, never "I lost my words". (2) Rewrite, never strip. The script repair drops whole off-script sentences, never letters from a word ("ने?"). A check-in’s offer is never cut to its last question ("Aap kya chunenge?"). Any non-closing turn the repairs leave under four words (unless it is exactly the pinned question) becomes the move’s full fixed line (a check-in’s fixed offer; with a card, its lead and question). Reversal: if a live replay shows the fixed lines replacing turns a second rewrite would have saved, add that rewrite before the fixed line.

md.decisions:
## dc-r7-brain-contracts (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

The round-7 seams everyone codes against are in shared/contracts.ts: the steer row (SteerId, 16 ids, each the request its words would make), the Later list as the screen shows it (LaterEntryUi), the conversational moment (UiMoment), TurnRequest.gameAct (game-consumed words are never graded), TurnRequest.heardUpTo on any lane, and ReplyClauseEvent for the streamed, clause-guarded reply. steer:wrap2 is read but waits for its move (A9). Test: tests/r7-brain-contracts.test.mjs.

## dc-r7-brain-one-band-table (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

One band table for the register: shared/learner.ts BANDS gains `register` (young 1-3, preteen 4-6, teen 7-9), and class 4 moves to the "10-15" band (decision D3). Learning’s twin and ageBandFor, Asha’s persona sheets and the agent lane all derive from it. A class-4 child gets the older sheet, peer protégé and turn lengths. Reversal: one row in BANDS if a live class-4 lesson reads worse. Test: tests/r7-brain-bands.test.mjs.

## dc-r7-brain-rewrite-never-strip (2026-11-04, stream A Brain)

She never narrates a build or a failure (no game ready, picture coming or failed, nothing moving, "I lost my words"); she offers what exists. Guard repairs never leave a fragment: off-script sentences go whole, a check-in keeps its offer, and a turn left under four words becomes the move’s full fixed line. Test: tests/r7-brain-rewrite.test.mjs.
